createDefinitionDraft.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. A new draft names package (+ version, parentDefinitionId, regressionFixtureRefs); a revised draft names definitionId and parentDraftRevision (= the lifecycle revision) and keeps the version. organizationId is optional, id/state/contentHash are server-assigned, unknown fields are TYPE_INVALID.

response.revision: lifecycle revision (expectedRevision of the next lifecycle command)

validateDefinition.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. Records a validation; APPLIED even when not publishable.

submitDefinitionReview.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. reviewKind DEFINITION (default; DRAFT→IN_REVIEW, needs a publishable validationId of the same hash) or WORK_MIGRATION (on a PUBLISHED package; migrationId, affectedWorkIds, mapping).

approveDefinition.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. A human other than the drafter and the submitter decides APPROVED or REJECTED (reason required); REJECTED returns the package to DRAFT. consumptionPolicy ONE_PACKAGE_PUBLISH (DEFINITION) or ONE_MIGRATION (WORK_MIGRATION).

publishDefinition.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. IN_REVIEW→PUBLISHED with a current unconsumed APPROVED approval of the hash; without one WAITING_APPROVAL. Published content cannot be resubmitted (no package slot).

activateDefinition.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. Moves the organization's single ACTIVE pointer to a PUBLISHED, not retired package (also a rollback to a prior package).

retireDefinition.note: Plan §8 package lifecycle; user decision 2026-10-11 (2): package is the stored Definition shape. RETIRED_FOR_NEW_WORK: no new Work may pin it; the ACTIVE pointer to it is removed; existing Work keeps its pinned meaning.

migrateWorkDefinition.note: Plan §8 explicit Work migration. The Work's human owner applies a current WORK_MIGRATION approval of the PUBLISHED, not retired target whose capability manifest lists migrationId in supportedWorkMigration and whose review names the Work. quantity {value,unit} and endpoint must equal the approved goalChanges. A new GoalVersion keeps previousGoalId; the approval is consumed (ONE_MIGRATION).

usage: Allowed slot names are not a guarantee that all are optional. Read live tools/list and server validation; keep returned outcome and unknowns.

Verb.name: string
Verb.slots: object mapping slot names to declared types

Goal.name: string
Goal.predicate: bounded typed predicate; unsupported operator is rejected

definitionPackageShape.notice: Use the current published definition as the typed input reference. These shapes do not grant support to arbitrary values; validateDefinition checks the installed capability/evaluator and returns problems. Regression execution remains NOT_RUN.
